sections.title: II. Read the following passage and choose the best answers A, B, C or D for these questions. (1.25 points)
sections.introHtml:
Dear Nam,

I’m glad to receive your email. Now I'm going to tell you about my house. My house is quite big. It has two floors. It also has an attic. On the ground floor, there is the hall, the kitchen, the living room and a dining room. On the first floor, there are three bedrooms and a big bathroom. My bedroom is between my parents' bedroom and the bathroom. My brother's bedroom is in front of my bedroom.

I love the attic the most. In the attic, I keep my books and my old toys. I like to spend my time there because it's quiet and I can do anything I like.

What about your house? Tell me in your next email.

Best,

Mike

sections.title: II. Write a paragraph (about 40 – 50 words) about your one of your close friends:

questions.html:
Suggestions:

1. What is his/ her name?

2. How old is she/ he?

3. What does he/ she look like? (her/ his appearance)

4. What is he/ she like? (her/ his personality)

5. Why do you like her/ him best?

The end
